$comment: CANONICAL INVENTORY of every Keycloak realm file this estate governs.
this file and validates exactly what it lists — it holds no realm list of
its own. The same file supplies the discovery roots used to detect a realm
that exists on disk but is missing from the inventory, so a renamed or
newly added realm cannot escape validation by simply not being listed.
Adding a realm file under a discovery root WITHOUT adding it here is a
hard failure, not a silent skip. That is the point.
keycloak_image must track the image the estate actually runs
A realm valid for one Keycloak major can be invalid for the next, so
validating against the wrong version proves nothing.
